findings.finding: Original annotations plus visual inspection show two almost identical car/truck boxes on the same background physical vehicle. Both map to vehicle and compete under one-to-one matching. Not a loader-added duplicate.
Original car/truck annotations overlap on the same right-hand black physical vehicle. Both retained after two-class mapping; one prediction cannot score two true positives.

Visual selection caveat: official person box is inside a bus window/door area and is not a clearly visible easy pedestrian. Size/density and finite frame exclusions did not guarantee every selected GT is easy. No completeness or label-invalidity claim is made.
Visible rider body prediction is shorter/narrower than the full-body GT, IoU below0.5. It is an unmatched localization prediction, not evidence of a hallucinated pedestrian on empty background.

Large visible foreground truck still lacks raw same-class box support at IoU0.25. This remains a genuine fitting limitation in this bounded diagnostic, not explained by TopK/NMS or final-score cutoff alone.

limitation: These are bounded source/visual findings on fixed training cases. Do not delete GT, change NMS, relax thresholds, or claim diagnostic80/road acceptance passed from them.
